instruction: Differential-Pair Labelling `mipi.kicad_sch` contains a MIPI D-PHY interface with 4 differential pairs drawn between an image sensor SoC (U1) and a 10-pin FFC connector (J1). The nets are currently named with arbitrary labels: D0A/D0B, D1P/D1N, CLK+/CLK-, D2plus/D2minus. A hidden property `PadConvention` on J1 states the pad numbering rule. Rename the 8 differential-pair nets to the standard MIPI D-PHY names below, using the pad convention encoded on J1 to decide polarity: - MIPI_D0_P / MIPI_D0_N (data lane 0) - MIPI_D1_P / MIPI_D1_N (data lane 1) - MIPI_D2_P / MIPI_D2_N (data lane 2) - MIPI_CLK_P / MIPI_CLK_N (clock lane) Requirements: 1. All 8 nets renamed exactly as listed above (uppercase `_P` and `_N` suffixes). 2. No original arbitrary net names remain as label text. 3. J1 Pad properties updated to reflect new net names. 4. U1 and J1 still present in the schematic. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch.
